build_jina_bert_config: build a JinaBertConfig with custom hidden size, attention heads, and feed forward type
create_jina_bert_embeddings: create a JinaBertEmbeddings layer from a safetensors handle with word and token type embeddings
run_jina_bert_self_attention: run the JinaBertSelfAttention forward pass with query key value projections and layer norm
